notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla spawns the over-the-head speech bubble for SAY/YELL/PARTY and monster say/yell: the ChatBubble-Background/Backdrop/Tail construct anchored above the speaker, word-count-scaled lifetime with the self-vs-other asymmetry, 250 ms fades, the 20 yd per-frame range gate, replace-never-queue, and the mutual exclusion with nameplates. MSUI has no chat bubble at all - the only 'bubble' in the codebase is the chat-menu button icon; say/yell/monster lines land in the chat log only, and NPC dialogue never appears over the speaker's head.
